scope: Independent read-only numeric/API and JSDOM handler review of the frozen Pilot intake. No plant control, model training, planner edits, deployment or physical/visual browser certification.

checks.time_and_coverage: Equivalent-offset/fractional-second duplicates rejected. Spring/autumn Cyprus windows have 23/25 hours, tested at 15- and 60-minute cadence. Exclusive end, invalid calendars, naive/off-grid times and telemetry available before observation fail closed. Missing and late slots remain distinct unknowns; no wall-clock review time inferred.
checks.numeric_contract: Closed min/max bounds preserve an actual zero. Nonfinite/nondecimal/out-of-range values, wrong units, undeclared streams, duplicate assets/headers, unsupported fields/source/schema/cadence and invalid reserves block all displayed numeric inputs.
checks.inert_imports: Declared __proto__, constructor and toString IDs work through Map keys without prototype authority. Own prototype-shaped JSON extras are rejected. Malicious source/asset labels and filenames remain inert text; no injected image/script/event SVG was created.
checks.identity_and_failure: Raw BOM/CRLF contract and CSV hashes match imported bytes. Original CSV export matches exact input bytes. Fatal UTF-8 failure and rejected declarations explicitly preserve the prior accepted intake. Blocked CSV clears numeric/chart/parsed-export values while retaining a separate original export.
checks.first_available_and_chart: Historical cutoff withholds late values from metrics/chart, retains source observations in the record, and exports every unknown slot. Point view leaves gaps blank; it does not interpolate.
checks.source_and_readiness: Synthetic/invented and operator-declared/unverified source labels remain distinct. COMPLETE with below-declared-reserve readings remains reviewRequired and is visibly NEEDS REVIEW. Coverage/readiness certifies neither origin, plant safety, water quality nor dispatch authority.
checks.isolation: Pilot controls hide the reference context and restore it on leaving. Imported tank bounds do not change selected reference capacity/date/plan source. Exact before/after plan CSV bytes and model/control metrics match. Intake performs no additional fetch, localStorage write, power integration, recovered-energy calculation or planner mutation.
checks.failed_reference: Pilot review/export remains available if the canonical manifest fails verification; reference plan actions stay disabled.
checks.DST_presentation: Explicit offsets and seconds distinguish repeated autumn readings; exact observation/first-available point titles use SVG DOM textContent. Earlier cutoff excludes the later repeated hour.
checks.final_UI_scope: Current source and executed handler regressions label end inventory at h+1 including24:00, keep 24 meter-clock slots with unknown daytime gaps, preserve Hold for correction without authorization language, label historical radiation as a reference, display friendly Pilot names/units while exported schema stays unchanged, and use singular blocking findings.
checks.publication_metadata: The EAC process is Undated in public research, with an explicit PDF-creation-metadata limitation. The regression and actual70-test suite pass; no publication year inferred from creation metadata.
checks.chart_edge_labels: Final generic chart source anchors first/last labels inward without changing point coordinates or time spans. The new edge-label regression passed in the actual71-test rerun; real rendered QA remains parent-owned.

limitations: JSDOM confirms handler behavior and DOM content; parent owns real-browser rendered QA.
Reviewer-supplied observations, provenance labels and numeric bounds are not authenticated or certified.
Observation intake is memory-local and disappears on reload; a user must export an explicit record to retain/share it.
Operator permission, approved plant envelope, calibrated measurements, water quality and brine constraints are outside this narrow numeric intake.
Offline CLI transport was read statically and found no blocker; its owner runs wrapper fixtures separately.
release_state: Final frozen Pilot source rechecked; no open P1/P2 findings.

resolved_findings.identified_by: Root review; missed by initial independent presentation review
resolved_findings.resolution: Cyprus stream/latest and review timestamps display seconds and UTC offset; each chart point carries exact ISO observation and first-available times through SVG title.textContent. The compact chart axis remains a short civil-time label; point titles disambiguate repeated instants.
resolved_findings.verification: Actual independent autumn handler fixture:03:00+03 and03:00+02 remain two distinct points/titles; cutoff03:01+03 retains only the first point and GMT+3 display.
